name: W. B. Pryor
role: Medora boot, shoe and leather shop owner
bio: W. B. Pryor of Dickinson came to Medora in the spring of 1885 and built a new shop for boots, shoes and leather work, mending harness and saddles as well. By mid-April 1885 his business had opened and he was looking for a shoemaker.

moments.label: Opened his boot and shoe business
